name: alexandria
description: Digest-bound lending-data releases with unsigned evidence statements, reviewed credit views and address queries.

interface.shortDescription: Digest-bound lending-data releases with unsigned evidence statements, reviewed credit views and address queries.
interface.longDescription: Alexandria preserves heterogeneous lending-protocol captures as unchanged digest-addressed objects, binds them to exact scope and coverage, emits unsigned in-toto statements after offline verification, derives reviewed Goldfinch and Clearpool credit rows, and rebuilds a disposable address index for Probitas. Statement signing, publisher identity, provider completeness and canonical-chain claims remain outside Alexandria. A separate Compound v3 Phase 0 path pins the Comet registry, captures a bounded RPC corpus and verifies its method gates offline; the resumable interval collector remains unimplemented.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $alexandria to preserve or verify this lending-data release, emit its unsigned in-toto statement, query its source-bound credit view, or build and check a bounded Compound v3 Phase 0 method release.
